_comment: Documentational manifest only. Trae IDE does NOT scan for plugin.json or marketplace.json — its AI assets (skills/commands/hooks/rules) are loose files under ~/.trae-cn/ (global) and .trae/ (project). This file exists for repo consistency with caveman-zcode/.zcode-plugin and caveman-codebuddy/.codebuddy-plugin, and to declare intent. The actual install is performed by scripts/install-trae.js, which lays assets into ~/.trae-cn/skills/, ~/.trae-cn/commands/, ~/.trae-cn/caveman-trae/{hooks,tools,agents}/, and merges ~/.trae-cn/hooks.json.
name: caveman
description: Ultra-compressed communication mode for Trae IDE. Cut filler. Keep technical accuracy. Supports intensity levels: lite, full, ultra, wenyan-lite, wenyan-full, wenyan-ultra.
